D=$(ls -1td /root/restore-test-* | head -1); python3 -c '
import sqlite3,sys,os
b=sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(sys.argv[1],"noco.db"))
Q=chr(34)
rows=b.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=?",("table",)).fetchall()
res=[]
for (t,) in rows:
    try:
        n=b.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "+Q+t+Q).fetchone()[0]
    except Exception:
        continue
    if n>0: res.append((n,t))
res.sort(reverse=True)
print("непорожніх таблиць:", len(res))
for n,t in res[:14]: print("   %-34s %d" % (t[:34], n))
b.close()
' "$D" 2>&1 | head -18
